newsitem.title: USA: US mortgage-backeds ease in narrow-ranged trade.
newsitem.headline: US mortgage-backeds ease in narrow-ranged trade.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backed securities shadowed their Treasury counterparts lower in narrow trading during a relatively quiet Tuesday afternoon session, traders said.

"Premiums tightened a little bit more than the discounts," said a trader, adding that "even with the discounts losing more ground than the rest of the list, they still tightened to the curve by a small amount."
"We saw some good selling of 7.5s in blocks of 150," another trader said.
Indeed, sellers pushed prices of pass-throughs 3/32 to 8/32 lower by late afternoon.
The five-year Treasury note was down 6/32 to yield 6.70 percent; the 10-year note fell 12/32 to yield 6.94 percent.
Late on Tuesday, Ginnie Mae 30-year 8.0 percent coupons were down 6/32 at 100-04/32, yielding 111 basis points over 10-year Treasuries.
Comparable FNMAs and FHLMCs both traded down 6/32 at 100-05/32 and 100-07/32, respectively.
